summary: P0 Service Speed (Durasi Pengerjaan) feature fully verified — backend 9/9 new + 82/82 regression GREEN, frontend POS speed-tier UI + multipliers + items_detail save + Admin 4-tier pricing UI all GREEN. The Durasi Pengerjaan pill section renders above tabs with 3 pills (Reguler default / Flash / Express). Cuci Kiloan rate updates correctly across speed tiers AND across source columns (Walk-in→umum 7000/10000/18500, Tamel→8000/12000/20000). Satuan & Sepatu apply ×1.5 (Flash) / ×2.0 (Express) on item-row prices and subtotals. Showcase prices remain flat across all tiers (verified Rp 20.000 unchanged). POS save flow persists items_detail with the speed label correctly: a Walk-in / Flash / 3kg order produced items_detail='Cuci Kiloan - Flash (1 Hari) - 3.0kg' and total_price=30000. Admin /admin → Pengaturan Harga renders the new 4-column table (Harga Umum / Tamel / Laskita / Kostunpad) with all 8 rows (3 kiloan_* + satuan/sepatu/jas/karpet/showcase), shows '4 TIER AKTIF' badge, and SIMPAN PERUBAHAN HARGA round-trip persists umum changes (verified 7000→7100 flow, then re-seeded). Final POST /api/seed/all called to restore canonical data.
critical_code_review_comments: Price model now uses `service_id: str` (was Literal) — correct relaxation since speed-tier rows are dynamic (kiloan_reguler/flash/express). Backward-compat ServiceId alias retained.
Price.umum field correctly defaults to 0 (ge=0) so older payloads without umum still validate; the Admin SIMPAN payload always includes umum so this is just a safety net.

POS items_detail formatting embeds the human-readable speed label (e.g. 'Flash (1 Hari)'). Note: server seed.py passes `items_detail=None` for kiloan dummy orders, so this label only appears on user-created orders — fine, but if you ever generate analytics from items_detail strings, parse defensively.

Showcase tier exemption is implemented client-side only (multiplier hard-coded to 1.0 for showcase tab). If a future product changes this, the rule lives in /app/frontend/src/components/POSScreen.jsx — consider centralising in pos/data.js next to SPEED_TIERS.

Admin pricing UI uses 64 numeric inputs (8 rows × 4 tier columns × 2? actually 32) — verified count=64 includes the qty-formatted display masks. SIMPAN payload still hits POST /api/prices/bulk which delete_many+insert_many atomically, so partial-write risk is nil.

Bulk endpoint accepts label/unit/umum/tamel/laskita/member but does NOT validate service_id uniqueness. A buggy admin payload with duplicate service_ids would persist both rows. Low-risk (only Admin-authenticated UI hits this) but worth a future PydanticValidator.
